format.frames: list of full poses in the poses[] format (root x/y + parts.rot, every part present). Play one per tick at fps. No blending, no IK needed: rotations are baked, the axe off hand lands on grip_off on every frame.
format.meta: per frame: label (key:<name> | breakdown:<name> | inbetween | hold | hit_stop), ease_in used to reach it, grounded (feet on ground_y), hit_stop
format.events: contact_frame = first frame of impact (fire hit sound + start hit-stop on BOTH bots); hit_stop_frames = duplicated frozen frames (skip them on a miss)
format.fx: attack strike smears: draw png at offset_rig_px (top-left, rig px, 1x) on that frame only, z 84 (just under the weapon). @2x file: same offset, draw at 0.5 scale. When the bot faces left, mirror the image and use x = 640 - (offset_x + width).
format.rots: stored continuity-unwrapped (no frame-to-frame jump > 180), so linear sub-frame blending between consecutive frames is also safe
